cases.title: Complete onboarding with optional lifts/photo skipped
steps: Fresh install with isolated local profile.
Complete goal, experience, supported days/equipment and units. Skip optional starting lifts and photo.
Inspect the recap and Today. Start the prescribed session.
Reopen onboarding-dependent settings and verify stored choices.
cases.expected: Valid starting plan; estimates explicitly identified; no invented lift history.
cases.evidence: UI + permitted local plan snapshot; no invented history.

cases.title: Back/forward and relaunch during onboarding
steps: Enter two onboarding answers; move back, change one, and move forward.
Background and force-terminate at the next step; relaunch without clearing data.
Complete onboarding once, then reopen the app twice.
Count created profiles, plans and account records through the approved test adapter.
cases.expected: Entered choices persist as designed; no duplicate account/plan creation.
cases.evidence: Before/after recording; local plan/profile counts.

cases.title: Deny notification/Health access, then start manually
steps: Reset permissions in a dedicated test installation. Decline notification and Health requests.
Continue the supported manual/on-device path; start and log a set.
Open check-in, Today and settings.
Verify no fabricated Health measurements and no repeated permission trap.
cases.expected: Manual workout remains usable; missing inputs are not shown as measured.
cases.evidence: Permission settings + UI + outbound-event trace.

cases.title: Save a check-in with each scale at its endpoints
steps: Open check-in with unanswered fields. Record the visible defaults without touching them.
Save only an explicitly changed field where partial input is supported.
Repeat each scale at minimum and maximum; inspect the saved local values and labels.
Reopen Today; confirm source/coverage labels match the local inputs.
cases.expected: Labels and stored direction agree; missing versus selected defaults remain distinct.
cases.evidence: Scale screenshots and local synthetic check-in records.

cases.title: Log two sets without touching RPE
steps: Open Bench in fixture F1. Leave reported RPE untouched for both planned sets; log 60 kg x 8 twice at realistic intervals.
Finish; open result, History, Progress and export preview.
Inspect stored targetRPE and reportedRPE through the test adapter.
Relaunch and compare.
cases.expected: No reported RPE is synthesized; average/debrief show missing coverage.
cases.evidence: Video + local records proving target 8 and reported null; no cloud payload.

cases.title: Log one actual RPE 8 and one missing RPE
steps: Log first set 60 kg x 8 with explicit reported RPE 8. Log second with reported RPE missing.
Finish and inspect History, summary, Coach read projection and card when enabled.
Confirm one report contributes, then reopen.
cases.expected: Exactly one report contributes to the average; coverage is 1 of 2.
cases.evidence: One-report coverage, null second RPE, computed mean evidence.

cases.title: Type `deadlift 60x8 @8` with Lunge visible
steps: Open Full C with Lunge active at bodyweight/zero added load.
Submit exactly deadlift 60x8 @8 once in typed logging.
Leave Lunge selected; inspect the log receipt and destination.
Read the two exercise occurrence records.
cases.expected: Only intended Deadlift receives the observation; receipt names it.
cases.evidence: Receipt, active selection and IDs in synthetic test trace.

cases.title: Open Plates after T07 without navigating
steps: Perform AU-07 without selecting Go to Deadlift.
Open Plate calculator from the still-visible Lunge.
Inspect label, load, equipment and bar applicability.
Close and reopen once.
cases.expected: No Lunge/Deadlift hybrid; equipment and load convention match one explicit context.
cases.evidence: Exact plate sheet screenshot; utility-context assertion.

cases.title: Navigate to Deadlift after T07, open Plates
steps: Perform AU-07; select Go to Deadlift.
Open Plates with the 20 kg bar and [20,10,5,2.5,1.25] kg plate inventory.
Compare the target and per-side result to fixture arithmetic.
Change display units and reopen.
cases.expected: All values use that exercise and the selected bar/plate inventory.
cases.evidence: 60 kg total = 20 kg bar + 20 kg each side; one-context assertion.

cases.title: Log a bodyweight exercise at zero added load
steps: Select the fixture bodyweight movement with zero added load.
Log actual reps; view History and any eligible card.
Open available loading tools; switch to an assisted movement fixture.
Verify its documented assistance convention, not a fabricated barbell convention.
cases.expected: Bodyweight label; no invented barbell prescription or missing-value substitution.
cases.evidence: Bodyweight/assistance labels and raw convention fields.

cases.title: Log an exercise not currently prescribed
steps: Record the planned-set denominator.
Type one set for a valid exercise absent from the plan.
Inspect whether it is extra work or a proposed prescription under the frozen product policy.
Retry the same operation ID; compare actual and planned totals.
cases.expected: Extra-set versus added-prescription policy explicit; denominator changes explained.
cases.evidence: Before/after counts; source policy reference; dedupe receipt.

cases.title: Retry/double-tap an identical log operation
steps: Submit a log, double-tap its button and replay the SAME operation ID through the test harness.
Inspect set count and receipts.
Submit two new operations with identical values deliberately.
Confirm the latter are two legitimate sets, not mistaken for a replay.
cases.expected: One intended observation and one receipt, not duplicate sets.
cases.evidence: Operation IDs + set counts + receipt assertions.

cases.title: kg/lb, decimal separator, per-dumbbell and machine cases

Enter values using the native keyboard and a typed command.
Save, reopen, switch display unit and switch back.
Compare raw values, labels, and conversions against F6.
cases.expected: One correct unit/convention conversion; no reinterpretation of stored load.
cases.evidence: Variant results; numerical assertions; localized screenshots.

cases.title: Finish a short/partial session

Finish early through the partial-workout flow.
Inspect result, eligibility message, next-update state and History.
Reopen and verify exactly one completion.
cases.expected: Observations saved once; neutral partial status; intended eligibility rule applied.
cases.evidence: Neutral partial result; persisted observation/commit counts.

cases.title: Reject/qualify implausibly rapid fixture sets

Finish and view History, PRs, awards, Progress and Crew eligibility.
Inspect selectors, not only labels.
Do not disable plausibility checks to make UI tests pass.
cases.expected: PRs/awards/analysis/Crew follow declared policies; History still preserves records.

cases.title: Background, force-kill and reopen an active workout

Resume and compare set IDs and timer policy.
Repeat with a device reboot and offline launch.
Finish once and compare next-plan receipt count.
cases.expected: Exact logged sets restored; timer policy preserved; no duplicate future progression.
cases.evidence: Uninterrupted video segments with labeled termination; durable state assertions.

cases.title: Complete session while adaptation/network step fails
steps: Inject failure AFTER durable completion is saved but BEFORE next-plan adaptation commits.
Finish; inspect saved/pending wording.
Relaunch, clear fault and allow the pending update to resume.
Replay completion delivery and inspect receipts.
cases.expected: “Saved; update pending” or equivalent; workout never lost.
cases.evidence: Fault point, saved set IDs, pending-to-committed transition; exactly one update.

cases.title: End duration, revisit/relaunch all relevant views
steps: Start a timed workout; pause/resume under the product policy; finish below one minute in a separate short fixture.
Compare final duration in summary, History, Timeline and eligible export.
Wait, relaunch and reopen each view.
cases.expected: Same stopped duration and consistent display policy everywhere.
cases.evidence: Frozen elapsed/pause oracle and one immutable completed duration.

cases.title: Edit 60 kg × 8 to × 9 and save

Edit reps to 9 and save.
Inspect History, relevant total, e1RM/PR eligibility and Timeline.

profiles.BASE: Representative supported real iPhone; release-candidate distribution build; English; kg; normal text; dark; stable network. Repeat smoke in light appearance.
profiles.SMALL: Smallest supported iPhone layout on the minimum supported OS; physical device for critical workflow. Record exact model/OS; screenshot-only simulator checks supplement, not replace.
profiles.LARGE_TEXT: Smallest supported layout at largest supported accessibility text; native keyboard; test essentials in light/dark. Record exact text-size setting.
profiles.JA: Japanese app language with a fluent reviewer; Japanese region/date input; supported real phone; applicable provider-locale flag recorded.
profiles.KO: Korean app language with a fluent reviewer; Korean region/date input; supported real phone; applicable provider-locale flag recorded.
profiles.REGION: English app language with decimal-comma region and lb, plus EN-US comparison; use test timezone boundaries including DST without assuming user location.
profiles.OFFLINE: Real device in airplane mode; test fresh permissions and documented cached entitlement; begin without cloud model/network and reconcile when restored.
profiles.VOICEOVER: Real iPhone, VoiceOver enabled and audio captured; test reading/interaction order, adjustable controls, status announcements and Reduce Motion.
profiles.WATCH: Supported paired phone and real Watch; record exact OS/model; connected, disconnected and later sync; include supported standalone behavior.
profiles.BILLING: Dedicated StoreKit/sandbox/TestFlight test identities with exact environment recorded; real device integration plus local StoreKit fault simulation.
profiles.PRIVACY: Synthetic staging accounts; approved decoded-payload inspection/local adapter assertions; sanitized app/backend/provider diagnostics; no real Health or personal data.
profiles.SLOW_DEVICE: Oldest/slowest supported real iPhone with minimum supported OS and large-history fixture; profile memory, energy, rendering and network failures.
profiles.USER_STUDY: Five consenting target lifters; isolated synthetic or voluntarily created test data; their familiar supported device where practical; no physical lifting required.

gates.CORE: Required core workflow, data correctness, accessibility, privacy or release control; never N/A merely because a bug blocks it.
gates.PAID: Required for the paid launch described by the user. Freeze actual products, storefronts, access and offline/expiry policy; do not reuse old draft prices.
gates.COACH: Required whenever the Coach is reachable/advertised; cloud-disabled variants still need local/fallback tests.
gates.VOICE: Required for each advertised voice capture/parser route; map local and cloud paths separately.
gates.APPLE_SURFACES: Resolve per advertised widget/Live Activity/Siri/notification surface. Split variants; do not waive all because one surface is unsupported.
gates.SPOKEN_COACH: Conditional on shipped event narration or spoken Coach; no assumption that dictation includes audio output.
gates.WATCH: Required if Watch is included/advertised; otherwise N/A only with owner-approved exclusion and listing/build evidence.
gates.SYNC: Required for enabled account sync, including guest merge and account isolation.
gates.AUTH: Required for every offered sign-in provider and account-owned endpoint.
gates.CREW: Required if reachable/advertised; include actual audience and content-safety operations.
gates.SHARING: Required for existing workout/program sharing when shipped, independently of Share Cards v2.
gates.SHARE_V2: Conditional on v2 core and individual template flags. Preserve ordinary sharing tests even when off.
gates.SHARE_NEXT: Conditional on reviewed next-target export flag; no pressure to turn it on for launch.

gates.JEV: Conditional on off/shadow/enabled by locale. Shadow cannot mutate; live locale evaluation required only for enabled routes.
gates.JEV_FOLLOWUP: Conditional on the single shorter-session follow-through loop; not an assumed shipped feature.
gates.FUEL: Required for enabled nutrition surfaces; test current formulas, not invent a new nutrition policy.
gates.PROGRESS_PHOTOS: Required for enabled private photos; separate from selected share backgrounds.
gates.GOALS: Required for enabled goal types; map actual supported types.
gates.EXPERIMENTS: Required for enabled experiments; outcomes use their approved evidence rules.
